capabilities: Run Python code blocks from rendered notes
Display stdout and errors in a modal
Copy execution results to the clipboard
Configure a custom Python executable path
extras: Desktop-only; does not work on Obsidian Mobile. Warns that Python code runs with Obsidian's OS permissions without sandboxing. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian renders Python code blocks as static text, so running snippets requires leaving the app for a terminal or IDE.
summary: Code runner that executes Python fenced code blocks with a local interpreter and shows stdout and errors in a modal.
